    Traces and rejects of interval representations #

    Lemma 6.3 of the manuscript, in the form used for the cutoff criterion:

    • the kernel of the projection M_{c,d} → M_{c,ℓ} is the suffix M_{ℓ+1,d} (kernelSubobject_intervalProj), so the quotient of M_{c,d} by the suffix M_{v,d} is M_{c,v-1} (cokernelSuffixIso);
    • for a quotient-closed T, the trace of M_{c,d} is the suffix M_{u,d} with u the least row in [c, d] such that M_{u,d} ∈ T, or zero if there is none (trace_interval_eq_suffix, trace_interval_eq_bot);
    • for a subobject-closed F, the reject of M_{c,d} is the suffix M_{b+1,d} with b the largest column in [c, d] such that M_{c,b} ∈ F, or all of M_{c,d} if there is none (reject_interval_eq_suffix, reject_interval_eq_top).

    theorem PretorsionImageClosed.LinearQuiver.imageSubobject_intervalIncl_comp_intervalProj {k : Type u} [Field k] {n : ℕ} {c u ℓ d : Fin n} (hcu : c ≤ u) (hℓd : ℓ ≤ d) :

      The trace of an interval #

      source
      theorem PretorsionImageClosed.LinearQuiver.trace_interval_eq_suffix {k : Type u} [Field k] {n : ℕ} {T : Statement.Subcategory (Statement.LinRep k n)} (hT : T.IsQuotientClosed) {c u d : Fin n} (hcu : c ≤ u) (hu : T.prop (interval k u d)) (hmin : ∀ (i : Fin n), c ≤ i → i < u → ¬T.prop (interval k i d)) :
      T.trace (interval k c d) = suffix c d u hcu

      Lemma 6.3: the trace of M_{c,d} is the suffix M_{u,d} for the least u ∈ [c, d] with M_{u,d} ∈ T.

      theorem PretorsionImageClosed.LinearQuiver.trace_interval_eq_bot {k : Type u} [Field k] {n : ℕ} {T : Statement.Subcategory (Statement.LinRep k n)} {c d : Fin n} (h : ∀ (i : Fin n), c ≤ i → i ≤ d → ¬T.prop (interval k i d)) :

      Lemma 6.3: the trace of M_{c,d} vanishes when no M_{u,d} with u ∈ [c, d] lies in T.
